title: The Perfect Sourdough Pizza (Bread Porn)
summary: A short, nearly wordless demonstration of making sourdough pizza at home using a cast iron pan and the oven. It shows a Neapolitan-style result without a pizza steel or stone.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a practical, home-bakable sourdough pizza method that gets close to stone-oven quality.

quote.text: This is the best video on making neapolitan style at home with an cast iron pan and oven
